title: Bound unrestricted expected queries by paired count flux
statement: For even d let P uniform and Q paired probabilities (1+/-delta sigma)/d with delta=4eta. Write lambda=m/d,mu=eta lambda. Conditional lost-trial shared-uniform binomial comparison yields an integer threshold interval I of size<=80(1+sqrt(lambda)+eta lambda) and sum of marginal CDF differences>=3mu. For the ACTUAL coupling, downward crossings have total deficit>=3mu, whereas retention bounds unnecessary surplus outflow by2mu. An independent uniform threshold yields alpha>=3mu/|I|, beta<=2mu/|I|, and KL>=(3log(3/2)-1)mu/|I|. Augment by independent selected label, WHOLE original X and other paired signs; these priors agree in this perturb-Q family. Per-Q stopped KL<=128eta^2/d and P/bits contribute zero. Some fixed target therefore has E N_Q>=c m/[eta(1+sqrt(m/d)+eta m/d)]. On d<=m<=d/eta^2 this is Omega(sqrt(md)/eta); elsewhere combine earlier mandatory m and d/eta bounds. Odd d uses an even subalphabet with zero remaining masses. Hence C*>=c[m+d/eta+sqrt(md)/eta] under UNBOUNDED actual stopping, with no source cap or exponential moment.
